**MPC TOOLS 1.2.0**, the first public release.

A second-screen dashboard for your Akai MPC, in one small Windows app:
- **Remote:** your MPC's screen live on your PC. Click to touch it, with Start / Play / Stop / Rec buttons.
- **OBS:** one link puts the MPC screen in OBS, for streams and tutorials.
- **File Browser:** move files between your PC and the MPC.
- **PC Folders:** your PC's folders inside the MPC's own browser (MPC Link by Padbangers, built in).
- **Save last 60 s:** one click saves the last minute of what the MPC played.

**Download** `MPC-TOOLS-1.2.0-windows-x64.exe` below. It's one file with nothing to install. Windows will warn that it's unsigned: click **More info → Run anyway**.

Each tab needs a small addin on the MPC. The [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-tools#what-you-need) lists every one, why it's needed and where to get it.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-tools/issues/new/choose).
